environment.description: Ktor 2.3.4 microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance with database user 'app_service' granted full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all application tables. No query-level firewall or pgAudit enforcement. Service runs with default Netty HTTP parser settings.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no HTTP inspection)
config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_service
